title: Conditional κ = .0038982141226643 (+0.00000015291874% over #8069; +0.00010575788118% over #8057): tighten the Gaussian debit booking
body:
## Verified result

**Conditional κ = 0.0038982141226643.** The exact campaign increase over independently reproduced [#8069](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/8069) at **0.0038982141167032** is **0.0000000000059611**, or **(1490275/9745535291758)%**. The candidate also clears the actual #8069 installed upper crossing. The difference over the latest comparable [external #8057](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/8057) at **0.00389821** is **0.0000000041226643**, or **(41226643/389821000000)%**. The same five signed all-size premises apply.

The complete unchanged Gaussian factor is strictly below the directed lower bound for 2^(64939/524288), with excess above **0.000000684423610889**. Booking 64939/524288 in place of 64944/524288 frees the allocation to use ordinary heights **(8192,124864,524288)** and Gaussian height **490638**. The old Gaussian debit fails at this height and target. The ordinary inequality binds at the new crossing. This is a paid debit and allocation change. The signed port schedule, physical work and restoration payments remain charged. The separate direct-sum fusion of calls 684 and 707 was excluded by both actual first-read chronology and recipient grade. [Exact screen receipts](https://github.com/ToikY/integer-mult-bounds/blob/f18b6a3da79474827601d28b7df9c85a753172a0/paired-768/r401/README.md)

| Resource | #8069 | This proposal | External #8057 |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| Recurring log₂ C upper bound | 318292451 | **318292171** | 318259431 |
| Maximum native height | 524288 | 524288 | 524288 |
| First terminal header | 2^1148465+4 | **2^1148456+2** | 2^1146239+4 |
| Entry conversion | 515 bits | 515 bits | 514 bits |
| Fixed setup | Conservative serial bound below 2^228 | Conservative serial bound below 2^228 | Trace-specific portable bound below 2^113 |

The recurring bound falls by 280 relative to #8069. #8057's published bound is 32740 log units lower. Its setup guarantee applies to the exact portable installation it measured. The candidate inherits the conservative native tape bound and does not compare those two setup figures as like-for-like measurements. [#8057 scientific replay](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/45070380100/job/137357150207)

```sh
python3.12 -IB scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-weighted-gaussian-debit
```
